note: Switch "battlePlate" (the war and geopolitics focus, council of 2026-11-27, question 5B): the same battle numbers underneath, with a plan, an earned stratagem and a reserve. The shapes come from Diodorus (the three-part plan that failed at Gela, 13.109.4-13.110.4; the men he distrusted sent first, 14.72.2-3; the survivors in the camp preserved by night, 15.17.4; after Magon fell Carthage sent to talk peace, 15.15.3-4; docs/research/war-and-towns.md); every number is invention.

plans.name: Hold the line
plans.text: Safe: if you are beaten by 2 or less, it is a draw instead. Against a general who comes on hard, +1.

plans.name: Strike a wing
plans.text: +1, and +1 more if your army is larger than theirs (their line is thinner).

plans.name: A combined attack
plans.text: +2 if both parts arrive in time. Each part rolls: on a 1 or 2 it comes too late, and each late part costs 2 (as at Gela in 405).
